object_policies.name: chat media delete owner or org admin
object_policies.using: ((bucket_id = ANY (ARRAY['chat-images'::text, 'chat-audio'::text])) AND ((owner = auth.uid()) OR (owner_id = (auth.uid())::text) OR ((split_part(name, '/'::text, 1) = (get_my_org_id())::text) AND (get_my_role() = 'admin'::text))))

object_policies.name: chat media insert scoped path
object_policies.check:
((bucket_id = ANY (ARRAY['chat-images'::text, 'chat-audio'::text])) AND (split_part(name, '/'::text, 1) = (get_my_org_id())::text) AND (split_part(name, '/'::text, 2) = (auth.uid())::text) AND (split_part(name, '/'::text, 3) <> ''::text) AND (array_length(string_to_array(name, '/'::text), 1) >= 4) AND ((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM app_users au
  WHERE ((au.id = auth.uid()) AND ((au.organization_id)::text = split_part(au.name, '/'::text, 1)) AND COALESCE(au.is_active, true)))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM autodrive_users adu
  WHERE ((adu.user_id = auth.uid()) AND ((adu.org_id)::text = split_part(objects.name, '/'::text, 1)))))) AND (((bucket_id = 'chat-images'::text) AND (lower(COALESCE((metadata ->> 'mimetype'::text), (metadata ->> 'contentType'::text), ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['image/jpeg'::text, 'image/jpg'::text, 'image/png'::text, 'image/webp'::text])) AND (COALESCE((NULLIF((metadata ->> 'size'::text), ''::text))::bigint, (0)::bigint) <= 10485760)) OR ((bucket_id = 'chat-audio'::text) AND (lower(COALESCE((metadata ->> 'mimetype'::text), (metadata ->> 'contentType'::text), ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['audio/aac'::text, 'audio/m4a'::text, 'audio/mp4'::text, 'audio/mpeg'::text, 'audio/mp3'::text, 'audio/ogg'::text, 'application/ogg'::text])) AND (COALESCE((NULLIF((metadata ->> 'size'::text), ''::text))::bigint, (0)::bigint) <= 20971520))))
